assumptions: Token sizing, not a quality result: removing a chunk can remove the one the answer needed; answer quality is not measured (FR-CTX-03).
S-6 (within-message dedup, Pipeline C) runs first: exact copies (same h_exact) are collapsed before ranking; their tokens are S-6's, not counted here.
Tokens = removed chunk characters x 0.3384 tokens per character (EDA recon.t0rag.coef_rag, hypothetical reconstruction), from uncached input only.
One result per baseline; recorded and repriced cost are never mixed, and each result states its unit in a 'Unit:' line (ADR-0036, ADR-0038).
A chunk without a score is kept and counted, never treated as 0; the floor keeps at least that many unique chunks per request.
The real bge-reranker-v2-m3 run (cut-first item a) was not done.
Scorer: heuristic word overlap of the normalised user message with each chunk (normalize_safe, word tokens, no stopword list).
Unit: price-file units (todays_models). Fees are not priced, so baseline_cost has no fees key (ADR-0036).

Logged tokens less the removed tokens are repriced with the price table's tiers (tier chosen again); every request at its logged model's price (the [baselines] price table, replay prices of ADR-0041); a logged model without a price leaves the row out (n_eligible_cost_known), never zero.
Headline chosen on the tune period (Mar-Jul 2026): top_k none, threshold q50 (0.2000), floor 3; most tokens saved with score mass kept >= 0.9 (tune 0.905); rule met: True. Reported on Aug-Oct 2026.
Slices all and llm_only; workflow rows have no cost. Tokens cover every eligible request; cost only those with a known cost (n_eligible_cost_known).
Cached tokens: the saving uses characters, not a_bill_inputTokens; the repriced baselines add cached tokens back for the five models (Review Focus 3).
Removed tokens are priced as uncached input (chunks assumed after the cached prefix); the saving is capped at input minus cached tokens.
Lexical: seeded sample of 2,000 eligible report-period requests; slices all and llm_only are that sample, so the cost share is of RAG requests only (observed: of all LLM requests).
The working tree had uncommitted changes when this ran.

Overhead: offline per-request estimate on a local machine; not a load test (Q-14). apply on one-row frames, 1000 seeded report-period LLM rows, 1 warm-up; p50 66.2951 ms, p95 84.8784 ms, max 174.7597 ms; 2026-11-02, AMD Ryzen 7 5800H with Radeon Graphics, CPython 3.13.9.
Overhead caveat: the headline point; chunks (and text) of the sampled rows are loaded before timing, so reading data is not timed; scoring and the cut are. Not a reranker model's latency.
